race.comment: DON'T DECLARE (2) brings the strongest exposed form and looks the horse to beat. He resumes after a long break, but a soft-track third at Ascot in NMW1Y grade and a fourth in the Listed Placid Ark Stakes read very well for a Mdn, and the inside draw with William Pike booked strengthens the case. SNOW MONKEY (9) is the clear danger after closing strongly for second at this track first-up, having also been tested in the G2 Karrakatta Plate last preparation. Can build on that performance with the fresh run under her belt. PLAYA DEL SOL (5) is fit and honest enough to be in the money. Back to 1100m now is no issue and she has the speed to get across and make her presence felt. GETS THE GIRLS (1) has been around a while without winning, but his Kalgoorlie third and Belmont Park fourth before the break keep him in the place mix. CALLTEX (10) won her latest trial nicely and can't be discounted here on debut.
